# Qingdao Jintian Textile Co., Ltd.

> China-based plush toy manufacturer since 1998, specializing in OEM/ODM/OBM production of stuffed animals, dolls, kids toys, baby products, baby textiles and holiday gifts for wholesale buyers worldwide. Brand: CHINOCO.

## About
Qingdao Jintian Textile is located in Qingdao, Shandong, China, with an in-house toy design studio (creator of the CHINOCO brand), BSCI-certified production bases with monthly capacity exceeding 100,000 units, and a subsidiary, Rizhao Jintian Textile Co., Ltd., established in 2008. The company has exhibited at the Canton Fair, Hong Kong Toys & Games Fair, and Christmas World Frankfurt.

## Products
- Plush toys (animals, characters)
- Dolls
- Kids toys
- Baby products (blankets, sofas, bags)
- Baby textiles (bedding sets)

Full catalog: https://chinocojintian.com/products.html

## Services
OEM, ODM, and OBM manufacturing for wholesale buyers and private-label brands.
